en.shortDescription: SharePoint Online WebDAV bridge for Nextcloud External Storage
en.longDescription:
Nextcloud SharePoint companion that runs an rclone WebDAV bridge in front of SharePoint Online (or on-prem NTLM SharePoint).

Set NEXTCLOUD_SHAREPOINT_SITE_URL to your library URL (for example https://tenant-my.sharepoint.com/personal/user_tenant_com/Documents) plus SERVICE_USER_SHAREPOINT / SERVICE_PASSWORD_SHAREPOINT (use an app password if MFA is enabled). In Nextcloud, enable External storage and add a WebDAV mount pointing at SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_SHAREPOINT. You can also use the official SharePoint external-storage app against Microsoft directly.

de.longDescription:
Nextcloud-SharePoint-Begleitdienst mit einer rclone-WebDAV-Bridge vor SharePoint Online (oder On-Prem-NTLM-SharePoint).

Setze NEXTCLOUD_SHAREPOINT_SITE_URL auf deine Bibliotheks-URL sowie SERVICE_USER_SHAREPOINT / SERVICE_PASSWORD_SHAREPOINT (App-Passwort bei MFA). In Nextcloud External Storage eine WebDAV-Freigabe auf SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_SHAREPOINT einrichten. Alternativ die offizielle SharePoint-App direkt gegen Microsoft nutzen.

fr.shortDescription: Pont WebDAV SharePoint Online pour le stockage externe Nextcloud
fr.longDescription:
Companion Nextcloud SharePoint qui expose une passerelle WebDAV rclone devant SharePoint Online (ou SharePoint NTLM on-prem).

Définissez NEXTCLOUD_SHAREPOINT_SITE_URL vers l'URL de la bibliothèque et SERVICE_USER_SHAREPOINT / SERVICE_PASSWORD_SHAREPOINT (mot de passe d'application si MFA). Dans Nextcloud, ajoutez un montage WebDAV vers SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_SHAREPOINT. L'app SharePoint officielle peut aussi se connecter directement à Microsoft.

pt.shortDescription: Ponte WebDAV SharePoint Online para armazenamento externo Nextcloud
pt.longDescription:
Companion Nextcloud SharePoint com uma ponte WebDAV rclone à frente do SharePoint Online (ou SharePoint NTLM on-prem).

Defina NEXTCLOUD_SHAREPOINT_SITE_URL para o URL da biblioteca e SERVICE_USER_SHAREPOINT / SERVICE_PASSWORD_SHAREPOINT (palavra-passe de app se MFA). No Nextcloud, adicione um montagem WebDAV para SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_SHAREPOINT. A app SharePoint oficial também pode ligar diretamente à Microsoft.
